summary: Iteration 49 testing complete. Verified 6 features: 1) Activities Excel Export - API returns activities for PRJ-0030 (8 activity docs verified via backend test), 2) Cashflow Sheet - API endpoint works with combined_data, wave_data, summary structure, 3) SAP Public Cloud Template - 6 phases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run) seeded and retrievable via by-combo API, 4) Template Excel Export/Import - buttons visible on Activity Templates page after selecting SAP S/4HANA + Public Cloud + Implementation, 5) Milestone Import - excelImport.js correctly identifies and skips milestone/activity/cashflow sheets from wave parsing, 6) Regression - Projects page, Milestones page, Cashflow page all working. Backend: 8/8 tests passed. Frontend: All pages load correctly.

issues: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1 - minor recharts sizing issue (pre-existing)

excelExport.js L651-709: Cashflow sheet correctly added with combined_data, wave breakdown, and summary
excelImport.js L48-72: Pre-scan correctly identifies milestone/activity/cashflow sheets and skips them from wave parsing
ActivityTemplates.js L136-240: Export Excel and Import Excel functions implemented for template management
activities.py L214-329: SAP Public Cloud template seeded with 6 SAP Activate phases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Activity Templates, Projects, Milestones, Cashflow pages verified)

seed_data_creation: Used existing PRJ-0030 v4 project (e33fb19e-b739-412b-9eb5-e3a392d5986e) with 8 activity docs. SAP Public Cloud template seeded via POST /api/activity-templates/seed-sap-public.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 49 verified: 1) Activities Excel Export - apiHeaders scope bug fixed by using localStorage.getItem('token') directly in handleExportToExcel. 2) Cashflow API returns {combined_data, wave_data, summary, payment_terms_days, payment_offset_months}. 3) SAP Public Cloud template has 6 phases: Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run. 4) Activity Templates page has Export Excel and Import Excel buttons (visible after selecting technology/project type). 5) excelImport.js skips milestone/activity/cashflow sheets from wave parsing. Backend tests in test_iteration49_features.py cover all APIs.

feature1_activities_excel_export.details: Backend test verified: GET /api/projects/e33fb19e-b739-412b-9eb5-e3a392d5986e/activities returns activity docs. ProjectEstimator.js L1649-1658 uses localStorage.getItem('token') for auth headers.

feature2_cashflow_sheet.details: Backend test verified: GET /api/projects/{id}/cashflow returns {combined_data, wave_data, summary, payment_terms_days, payment_offset_months}. excelExport.js L651-709 adds Cashflow sheet to Excel export.

feature3_sap_public_cloud_template.details: Backend test verified: POST /api/activity-templates/seed-sap-public seeds 6 phases. GET /api/activity-templates/by-combo returns 6 phase templates with activities for SAP S/4HANA + Public Cloud + Implementation.

feature4_template_excel_export_import.details: UI test verified: Activity Templates page shows Export Excel and Import Excel buttons after selecting SAP S/4HANA + Public Cloud + Implementation. 6 phases displayed with activities/deliverables counts.

feature5_milestone_import_skip.details: Code review verified: excelImport.js L48-72 pre-scans for milestone/activity/cashflow sheets and skips them from wave parsing (lines 70-72).

feature6_regression.details: UI test verified: Projects page shows 30 projects including PRJ-0030. Milestones page and Cashflow page load correctly with project lists.
